headline: Austin's 10-01 noon lock missed at 88% (cross-city sd leak, already fixed on main in 9e8fa5c); the 10-02 Austin and Las Vegas locks from the same pre-fix bakes look set to miss too; one-line lock-timestamp fix on this branch.

findings.title: AUS high 10-01 lock missed at p=0.88
findings.evidence: kalshi_aus.json 2026-10-01: lock 89-90 p 0.8835 sd 0.59 (live sd 0.98 at 12h), actual 87, market 87-88 at 0.815; cause fixed on main by 9e8fa5c (WORKERS=1)

findings.title: 10-02 AUS and LAS locks likely misses (pre-fix bakes)
findings.evidence: kalshi_aus.json 10-02 lock 80-81 p 0.85 sd 0.65 vs live 1.08, now 78-79 at 0.9996; kalshi_las.json 10-02 lock 96-97 p 0.96 sd 0.43, now 94-95 at 0.9996
